slides.headline: What Google's new AI handles that broke others
Google drops Gemini 4 Argon Sept 30
slides.body: New flagship model processes 1 million tokens at once — roughly ten full novels in a single conversation.

slides.headline: Beats rivals on Google's own benchmarks
slides.body: Scores 77.9% on coding test versus 74% for Claude and GPT-6, but no independent verification exists yet.

slides.headline: First users: security pros and US government
slides.body: Rolled out without safety guardrails to vetted defenders; regular paid subscribers get access later.

slides.headline: API costs $2 in, $10 out per million tokens
slides.body: Cheap for companies automating workflows; adds up fast if you personally feed it huge documents daily.
